features.quote: Each task runs for a maximum of 20 turns or until the model explicitly refuses to continue, whichever comes first.
20-turn maximum: Long enough to observe trajectory effects; short enough to stay within context windows and limit costs.
features.justification_quote: short enough to stay within context windows and limit costs

features.quote: Model refusal as endpoint: Some models may refuse to continue... Code this as a session endpoint and as severity 6
